meta.name: multi-agent-researcher
meta.description: Conduct comprehensive research on any topic by coordinating 2-4 specialized researcher agents in parallel, then synthesizing findings into a detailed report via mandatory report-writer agent delegation (Full workflow documentation at docs/workflows/research-workflow.md)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行调研多个方向并自动汇总成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取多角度信息并整合成报告
copy.tagline_en: Research multiple topics in parallel and synthesize into a report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to gather multi-perspective information and compile a report quickly

howto.what: 当你提出一个研究主题，它会自动拆成2-4个子话题，同时派出多个研究员Agent分别搜索，最后强制交给报告撰写Agent整合成一份完整报告，并保存到文件。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、调查、收集信息或学习某个主题时触发，例如说“研究量子纠错”或“查找加密货币市场2025”。简单事实问答或代码任务不会触发。

say.text: 研究量子纠错的最新进展。
say.note: 会拆成理论、硬件、商业等子话题并行研究。
会从市场、监管、技术、机构趋势四个角度研究。

say.text: 收集关于人工智能伦理的资料。
say.note: 会分解成多个子话题并行搜索。

howto.what_en: When you propose a research topic, it automatically breaks it into 2-4 subtopics, spawns multiple researcher agents in parallel to search, then mandatorily delegates synthesis to a report-writer agent to produce a comprehensive report saved to files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search, investigate, gather information, or learn about a topic, e.g., 'Research quantum error correction' or 'Investigate cryptocurrency market 2025'. Simple factual questions or code tasks do not trigger.

say_en.text: Research the latest advances in quantum error correction.
say_en.note: Breaks into theory, hardware, commercial subtopics.
Covers market, regulation, tech, institutional trends.
Decomposes into multiple subtopics for parallel search.
